params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, amber core glow, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. STRICT: absolutely no faces, no helmet faces, no eye pairs, no mouth plates anywhere; any armor follows ONLY the reference image suit design (single horizontal amber visor slit, swept crest fin, hexagonal amber chest core); nothing may resemble Iron Man or any Marvel character. Subject: a command deck mission control — tiered rows of consoles facing a large central holographic map table showing a miniature city of glowing districts, red and gold panel walls decorated only with a plain geometric hexagon relief (flat abstract shape, nothing inside it), a wide observation window band.
